selected_workflow.name: vliw-bundle-packing-optimization-2
selected_workflow.description: VLIW bundle-packing and SIMD vectorization workflow for a custom-VLIW Python-simulator task: packs independent scalar operations into multi-slot VLIW instruction bundles (up to 12 ALU + 2 LOAD + 2 STORE + 1 FLOW + 6 VALU per cycle), then applies SIMD vectorization (VLEN=8 VALU) where the data layout permits. Uses a Session-local candidate copy with SHA-256 binding, runs the mandated correctness and benchmark commands, and returns the speedup and best kernel code.
